domain_guidance.summary: Medical‑Surgical Clinical Nursing evaluates a nurse’s competence in detailed patient assessment, individualized care planning, implementation of evidence‑based interventions, and systematic evaluation of outcomes for adult patients experiencing a wide range of surgical and medical conditions.

Pathophysiology and Disease Processes tests the nurse’s understanding of underlying disease mechanisms, typical clinical manifestations, and how pathophysiologic alterations influence nursing assessments, prioritization, and therapeutic decision‑making across diverse medical‑surgical diagnoses.

Nursing Interventions and Therapeutics focuses on selecting, adapting, and applying evidence‑based treatments, safe medication administration, and appropriate therapeutic procedures to address daily complex patient needs within the medical‑surgical setting.

Patient Safety and Quality Outcomes assesses knowledge of safety principles, error prevention strategies, risk assessment, and quality improvement methodologies that nurses employ to enhance patient outcomes and maintain high standards of care.

Complex Care Management examines the coordination of multidisciplinary teams, integration of detailed care plans, and management of patients with multiple comorbidities or high‑acuity conditions to ensure seamless, patient‑centered delivery of services.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive early, bring a valid ID, and ensure you have a quiet space for the linear, computer‑based test. Manage time wisely, answer every question, and stay calm throughout the 180‑minute session.

faq.answer_text: The CMSRN exam consists of 150 multiple‑choice questions presented in a linear format. All questions must be answered within the allotted 180 minutes during the testing session.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: Passing is determined by a scaled score set by the Medical‑Surgical Nursing Certification Board (MSNCB). The exact numeric threshold is not disclosed, but the scaled score reflects competency across all domains.

The test duration is 180 minutes, which provides candidates with roughly one minute per question for the 150‑question multiple‑choice format, allowing sufficient time to read, analyze, and select the best answer for each item.

The CMSRN credential is valid for five years. Renewal is required after that period, and candidates must meet ANCC’s renewal requirements to maintain active status and demonstrate ongoing professional development.
faq.question_title: How often must I renew the CMSRN certification?

editorial.overview: The Certified Medical‑Surgical Registered Nurse (CMSRN) credential, offered by the ANCC, assesses competence across five domains: clinical nursing, pathophysiology, interventions, safety outcomes, and complex care management. The linear, 150‑question multiple‑choice test lasts 180 minutes and costs $349. Successful candidates earn a five‑year certification that requires renewal, and they must complete continuing education and practice requirements to maintain active status.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Allocate study time to each of the five domains, using ANCC’s exam guide and practice questions. Focus on core topics, review current guidelines, and complete timed mock exams to build stamina for the 180‑minute, 150‑question format. Reinforce learning with case studies and review the scaled passing standard set by MSNCB to ensure you meet the competency threshold.
editorial.who_should_take: Registered nurses who work primarily on adult medical‑surgical units, or who have substantial experience managing acute and chronic conditions in that setting, should consider the CMSRN to demonstrate advanced proficiency and readiness for leadership roles.

exam_price_notes: $349. Administered by MSNCB (Medical-Surgical Nursing Certification Board), an affiliate of AMSN.
exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials permitted. On-screen calculator provided where applicable. 60-day waiting period required before retaking. MSN or APRN graduate degree required for advanced practice NP certifications.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name must match ANCC registration exactly. RN license number required at check-in.

lifecycle.summary: MSNCB's CMSRN certification page is live and describes an exam on offer now: 'After identifying a need for a medical-surgical certification, the Certified Medical-Surgical Registered Nurse (CMSRN) exam was created and MSNCB was established', with current mechanics - 'To pass the CMSRN exam, you must achieve a standard score of 95, which is about 71% correct. Your raw score, the number of correctly answered questions out of 125, is converted to a standard score' - and live eligibility rules. No retirement or successor language anywhere on the page.

prerequisites.description: 2 years of med-surg RN practice and 2,000 hours in med-surg nursing within 3 years

renewal_options: Earn 75 CE credits (contact hours) every 5 years. CE credits must be relevant to the certification specialty. Submit renewal application via the ANCC certification portal. Maintain current, active RN license throughout certification period.

retake_policy.notes: Must wait 60 days before retaking. Full exam fee required for each retake attempt. Check ANCC website for current retake policies.

testing_centers.notes: Computer-based testing at Prometric test centers; online proctoring available for select exams
